description: This file defines the GatewayPushSubscription enum which includes static methods to manage subscription to GatewayPush streams, handling push notifications, restarting tasks, and interacting with GatewayConnection.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Asynchronously subscribes to a push stream and calls the provided closure on each push, respecting task cancellation and ensuring execution on the main actor.

methods.name: restartTask
methods.description: Cancels the existing task if present and starts a new task to consume push stream, invoking the provided closure on each push.
